episodes.title: Deine Spuren im Sand
episodes.summary: Helgoland, 2039: A child is born. Because the island is sealed off from the outside world due to a pandemic, no more than 513 residents are tolerated. Who has to die?

episodes.title: Auf Wiedersehen
episodes.summary: Linus, son of island doctor Marek, volunteers for a dangerous mission on the mainland. Meanwhile, an alarm goes off in the water treatment plant.

episodes.title: Marmor, Stein und Eisen bricht
episodes.summary: After returning from the mainland, a resident succumbs to the virus, whereupon island boss Beatrice looks for the culprit. Marek is researching an antidote because Linus is also infected.

episodes.title: Da Da Da
episodes.summary: Marek realizes that the lab ship Linus was talking about is their only hope. On land, Hendrik, Beatrice's outcast son, teams up with the gang boss "the Count".

episodes.title: Stark sein
episodes.summary: Islander Ewelike's wife, who lives on the mainland, is applying for the island, but she has a competitor, medical student Daniela. Linus' condition worsens.

episodes.title: Ein Lied zieht in die Welt hinaus
episodes.summary: Ewelike is seriously accused by Beatrice, Marek does not contradict her. He then tells his terminally ill son how it all began and also how Beatrice came to power.

episodes.title: Porque te Vas
episodes.summary: While a squad is forming on the mainland to head for the island, Marek wants to make a confession on the island. But Daniela asks him to wait another two hours.
